notes:
Inbound SMB legaltech — building a contract-first assistant for boutique law firms.
Shipped self-serve sign-up; used hosted API with free credits to run early tests (embeddings + summarization).
Primary concerns: confidentiality of client docs, audit trail for every model call, and US-only data residency (clients are US firms).
POC ask: ingest ~5k redacted contracts (customer will mask PHI) to validate retrieval + summarization. Target latency: 200-400ms for short QA queries; throughput ~8-12 qps during business hours.
Security parity requests: confirm SOC2 Type II report, provide BAA template, detail audit logging retention and export format (they want per-request metadata: timestamp, route, model, tokens, user-id).
Quote from CTO Sara Li: "We can't move forward without explicit confirmation we can purge customer data and get per-call audit logs — this is non-negotiable for our clients."
Pricing sensitivity: small ARR expected initially; they are cost-aware. Interested in hosted API (self-serve) for speed to market.
Other tech notes: prefer us-east-1 or us-west-2 region; plan to use SDKs (python) and server-side routing; want clear guidance on embeddings cost and caching recommendations.
Next tangible: provide sandbox key + sample prompt set, SOC2 evidence, and BAA draft. SE to send sample curl snippets for embedding caching and recommended batch sizes.
Follow-up owner: Marcus — keep in-touch weekly until POC starts.
